name: ONTHAI Lab
tagline: Ontology for Health AI and Informatics
description: ONTHAI Lab connects biomedical informatics, evidence synthesis, biomedical ontology, health AI, digital health, and population health research to build practical, data-informed solutions for communities.
aboutDescription: ONTHAI Lab brings together researchers, students, and collaborators to conduct evidence synthesis and develop trustworthy health data, biomedical ontologies, health AI, and digital tools for digital and population health.

affiliation.label: Research Laboratory
affiliation.name: Ontology for Health AI and Informatics
affiliation.institution: Based at Sirindhorn College of Public Health Khon Kaen
affiliation.faculty: Faculty of Public Health and Allied Health Sciences, Praboromarajchanok Institute, Ministry of Public Health.

focusAreas.title: Biomedical Informatics & Evidence Synthesis
focusAreas.description: Systematic reviews, meta-analyses, research literacy, and data-informed methods for public and population health.

focusAreas.title: Biomedical Ontology & AI
focusAreas.description: Knowledge representation, formal ontologies, artificial intelligence, and semantic methods for health research.

focusAreas.title: Digital & Population Health
focusAreas.description: Health information systems, epidemiological informatics, and practical digital tools for communities and health workers.
